wf_augi_01.details: Existing catalog tools list component mass tables but cannot compare chassis options side by side in 3D. Sable gives the team one shared workspace to test structural trade-offs.

wf_augi_01.reason: Existing 2D mass tables lack 3D geometry and load checks, which Sable Studio and Sable Balance provide.

sourceExcerpts.author: Lukas Lindner
sourceExcerpts.role: Lead Chassis & BIW Architect, AUGI Sable
sourceExcerpts.text: Using our Bredt-Batho closed-section torsion approximation for the AUGI Sable skateboard, compare SABLE-A (modular 6082-T6 extrusion + bolt-in pack, 3040 mm wheelbase, 1690/1700 mm track, 3.2 mm wall) against SABLE-B (Cell-to-Body 82% pack shear coupling + 22MnB5 boron torque rings, 3.0 mm wall). What happens if we stretch wheelbase to 3120 mm?

sourceExcerpts.author: Kenji Takahashi
sourceExcerpts.role: Senior Sill Extrusion & Underbody Load-Path Engineer
sourceExcerpts.text: Sweep the 6-chamber AA 6082-T6 rocker extrusion wall gauge from 2.2 mm to 4.5 mm in 0.2 mm steps on SABLE-B (195x135 mm section) and SABLE-C (200x135 mm section with AlSi7Mg C611 megacastings). Plot structural mass (kg) vs torsional stiffness (kN·m/deg).
